When to Use Supervised Mode Instead of Autopilot

Autopilot is fast. Sometimes that's the wrong call.
Use supervised mode on anything touching production data or payments.
Autonomous mode is great for routine, low-risk tasks.
Match the mode to the stakes, not just your mood.
